_about: Sarvam AI second opinion: Sarvam-105B line review for Hindi, Bengali and Tamil; Sarvam Translate back-translations for Urdu (Sarvam-105B does not support Urdu). Lists every Hindi, Bengali and Tamil suggestion not applied exactly, and each Urdu line whose back-translation looked off but was kept, with the reason. Lines not listed were judged ok. Tamil also lists each meaning difference found against the independent Sarvam translation (keys ending '(independent)').

hi.event.souvenirNote: सोवणियर is a misspelled loanword and less known than the glossary term स्मृति-चिह्न; the rest is style.

hi.ui.scam: स्कैम is the glossary term used across the Hindi; ठगी in one label breaks consistency.
hi.ui.saving: Style; परिणाम is common and matches other result labels.
hi.ui.allCorrectMsg: Inserts Latin-script 'souvenir'; स्मृति-चिह्न is the glossary term and the length fits.
hi.ui.partialMsg: Latin-script 'souvenir'; keeps glossary स्मृति-चिह्न as in the other souvenir lines.
hi.ui.attempt: Style; प्रयास is common and short.
hi.learn[0].tagline: स्कैमर is the glossary term used across the Hindi.
hi.learn[0].chat.lines[1]: Style; ट्रांसफ़र is what real payment demands say, and भेज दें would repeat भेज in the same line.
hi.learn[0].chat.lines[3]: Present continuous for an action about to happen is natural Hindi; meaning unchanged.
hi.learn[1].chat.from: दीपावली is used in every other line (greeting, quiz) and matches the event name.
hi.learn[2].tagline: Sarvam was wrong: खाते के इस्तेमाल के बदले is correct (oblique before के बदले).
hi.learn[2].flags[1].label: The scammer is the implied subject, as in the other flag labels (आपका OTP माँगता है).
hi.learn[3].tagline: Sarvam was wrong: पत्र is plural here (English 'letters'), so माँगते हैं agrees.
hi.learn[4].tagline: Style; फ़ोन पर आया कोड is natural everyday Hindi.
hi.learn[4].flags[0].label: जल्दबाज़ी कराता है also appears in learn[1].flags[2].label, which Sarvam passed; left both for a native speaker to judge together.
hi.learn[4].todo[0]: Style; one अपना already covers both nouns.
hi.learn[5].flags[0].label: पर खत्म होना is the natural way to say 'ends with'; तक नहीं आती is unclear.
hi.learn[5].todo[0]: Style; the draft names the sender, which is the point of the line.
hi.learn[5].todo[1]: पर खत्म होती is natural; the suggestion also introduces an error (पहला "/" से पहले).
hi.act.items[2]: Every ACT/ADD/CHECK/TELL item pairs the English word with a Hindi verb for readers who do not read English.
hi.quiz[1].cards[0].from: नियोक्ता is the glossary term; मालिक is a fair alternative for the language team to decide site-wide.
hi.quiz[1].cards[1].text: In a scam message 'खाता बंद' still reads as a blocked account; the suggestion also drops 'we just sent'.
hi.quiz[1].cards[2].why: बनाने का (offer to make you a mule) keeps the meaning; the rest is style.
hi.quiz[1].cards[3].why: A short label fragment, natural as is.
hi.quiz[2].chat.lines[1]: चला गया (went to your phone) is natural from the sender's side.
hi.quiz[2].options[2]: Hindi needs an object here; कोड makes 'it' clear.
hi.quiz[2].explain: CHECK stays English only as the ACT/ADD/CHECK/TELL label, not every 'check'; the suggestion also switches to the informal मत बताओ.
hi.quiz[3].options[1].label: Style; संदेश is used in every other chat label.
hi.quiz[3].options[2].label: Style; में दिया लिंक is natural.
hi.quiz[3].explain: Applied in part: लिंक वाले ऐप (apps with links) became लिंक से मिले ऐप (apps got from links); kept अपने (reflexive) rather than आपके.
hi.quiz[4].msg.channel: Style; संदेश matches the other chat labels.
hi.quiz[4].msg.bubbles[2][0].t: This is a fake message, not the CHECK label; the suggestion leaves a broken sentence.
hi.quiz[5].explain: Sarvam was wrong: अपना बैंक खाता इस्तेमाल करने देना is standard Hindi.

bn.ui.legal: {privacy}-এ সম্মত is correct Bengali (agree to); placeholders unchanged.
bn.ui.exitQuiz: Style; বের হন is the usual button wording.
bn.ui.exitConfirm: মুছে যাবে (erased) and হারিয়ে যাবে (lost) mean the same here; style.
bn.ui.quizTitle: স্মারক উপহার is the glossary term for souvenir, used in every souvenir line.
bn.ui.quizTitleAfter: কুইজ দিন follows পরীক্ষা দেওয়া, the usual idiom for taking a test.
bn.ui.left: আর {n}টি ... বাকি is natural Bengali for 'n left'; glossary term kept; it fits.
bn.ui.whatToDo: Sarvam was wrong: কী (what) is correct; কি is the yes/no particle.
bn.ui.allCorrectMsg: Glossary term স্মারক উপহার kept; 'your' is implied in Bengali.
bn.ui.earnedBefore: সব সঠিক mirrors ui.allCorrect (সব সঠিক!); বৈধ (valid) is the right word for a QR code.
bn.ui.notSaved: Sarvam was wrong: its "spelling fix" is the same word; এখনও/এখনো are both standard.
bn.learn[0].title: কর্মকর্তা (officer) is used in every officer line; style.
bn.learn[0].tagline: নিজেদের ... বলে দাবি করে is natural Bengali for 'pretend to be'.
bn.learn[1].flags[2].label: তাড়াহুড়া দেয় is ungrammatical; the draft is fine.
bn.learn[2].todo[1]: আপনার জেল হতে পারে is the natural Bengali construction.
bn.learn[3].todo[0]: Style; নিজেই carries 'yourself' from the English.
bn.learn[4].todo[1]: Sarvam was wrong: সে is gender-neutral in Bengali.
bn.learn[5].todo[0]: Inserts Latin-script 'sender' and drops সরকারি (government) for সরকার.
bn.learn[5].todo[1]: "/"-এর আগের ওয়েবসাইটের নাম reads as 'the website name before the "/"'; the suggestion drops 'website'.
bn.act.items[1]: Style; যাচাই করুন matches the other 'check' lines.
bn.act.items[2]: Sarvam was wrong: বন্ধুদের জানান means 'tell friends' (-দের is also the object case).
bn.quiz[1].cards[1].text: The suggestion means 'answer it', not 'reply with it'; the draft is correct.
bn.quiz[1].cards[1].why: The draft is natural; the suggestion uses archaic বলিলেও.
bn.quiz[1].cards[2].from: পরিচিতি is the word Bengali phone menus use for a contact.
bn.quiz[1].cards[2].why: বানানোর প্রস্তাব (offer to make you a mule) keeps the meaning; style.
bn.quiz[3].prompt: Sarvam was wrong: আপনি ... চান is standard; চাই would mean 'I want'.
bn.quiz[5].options[2]: Style; এটি/করব are used consistently across the Bengali.
bn.quiz[5].explain: Style (এটি, এবং); the suggestion also drops 'bank'.
bn.feedback.csatQuestion: Style; অনুষ্ঠানে খুশি is natural (same line kept after the SEA-LION check).

ur.ui.csr: Back-translation garbled the word order; the draft says 'a Corporate Social Responsibility initiative of GovTech'.
ur.ui.partialMsg: 'try gift wrap again' is a back-translation slip; the draft says 'try again for a gift'.
ur.ui.afterFull: The idiom 'in a mile' is the translator's; the draft says 'you can recognise fraud'.
ur.ui.unsure: یقین نہیں means 'not sure'; 'don't believe it' is the translator's reading.
ur.learn[0].todo[1]: The draft has 'Unsure? Hang up.' (فون بند کر دیں); the back-translation dropped it.
ur.learn[1].flags[2].label: جلدی کرواتا ہے means 'makes you hurry'; the translator misread the subject.
ur.learn[2].title: The draft has فراڈ میول (glossary term for scam mule); the translator turned it into 'Fraud Revealed'.
ur.learn[2].tagline: The draft says 'paying money in exchange for using your bank account'; 'cash instead of' is a mistranslation.
ur.learn[2].chat.lines[1]: اپنا refers to the person addressed ('your'); the translator read it as 'my'.
ur.learn[2].todo[1]: The draft has بید کی سزا (caning); 'or worse' is the translator's paraphrase.
ur.learn[3].todo[1]: The draft has both sentences with the right meaning; the back-translation reversed the first and dropped the second.
ur.learn[4].tagline: The draft says 'the code that came to your phone'; 'entered while dialing' is a mistranslation.
ur.learn[5].todo[1]: The draft says 'look at the website name before the first "/"'; the back-translation garbled it.
ur.quiz[0].msg.bubbles[0][1].t: The draft says 'your work permit has a $350 fine outstanding'; 'immigration office' and 'late fees' were added by the translator.
ur.quiz[1].cards[0].from: مالک (employer, the settled term) can also mean 'Lord'; the translator chose that reading.
ur.quiz[1].cards[1].why: The draft says 'even if they call themselves your bank'; 'including your own bank' is a mistranslation.
ur.quiz[1].cards[2].why: The draft has 'an offer to make you a فراڈ میول'; the translator dropped 'mule'.
ur.quiz[2].chat.from: The draft has کزن (cousin); 'Kisan' is a transliteration slip.
ur.quiz[4].msg.bubbles[1][0].t: اپنی نوکری refers to the reader's job; the translator read it as 'my job'.
ur.quiz[5].chat.lines[1]: اپنا refers to the person addressed ('your'); the translator read it as 'my'.
ur.quiz[5].options[1]: اس کے بدلے $400 asks for $400 in return; close enough to 'instead'.
ur.quiz[5].explain: The draft says 'you become a فراڈ میول'; 'vulnerable to fraud' is a mistranslation.

ta.ui.translations: Live reads 'English version is the source', the same meaning; the suggestion is style.
ta.ui.exitQuiz: Short button label kept on purpose ('Exit' inside the quiz screen); the suggestion is longer and ungrammatical (needs 'விட்டு').
ta.ui.quizTitle: வினாடி வினா is the standard Tamil word for quiz and is used on every quiz line; Latin-derived குவிஸ் would break consistency.
ta.ui.quizTitleAfter: Same as ui.quizTitle: keeps வினாடி வினா.
ta.ui.afterFull: 'அடையாளம் காண உங்களுக்குத் தெரியும்' is correct; the suggestion drops 'you'. Style.
ta.ui.afterPartial: முயலுங்கள் is standard and shorter; 'முயற்சி செய்யுங்கள்' would lengthen the line.
ta.ui.example: போலி (fake) is right for a label on a made-up scam message; style.
ta.ui.toQuiz: எழுதுங்கள் follows the idiom for taking a test (same call as SEA-LION triage); விளையாடு (play) trivialises it.
ta.ui.allCorrectMsg: 'நினைவுப் பரிசைப் பெற' (to get the souvenir) is natural; style.
ta.ui.earnedBefore: செல்லுபடியாகும் (valid) is correct and precise; the colloquial suggestion is a register preference.
ta.ui.wrong: Sarvam was wrong: சரியல்ல (சரி + அல்ல) is standard written Tamil.
ta.learn[0].chat.lines[3]: Sarvam was wrong: 'அழைப்பைக் காவல்துறைக்கு' is correct sandhi (accusative ஐ before க doubles).
ta.learn[0].flags[2].label: Sarvam was wrong: same correct sandhi as learn[0].chat.lines[3].
ta.learn[0].todo[1]: Live is grammatical and clear; the suggestion mixes colloquial போலீசு with the glossary term காவல்துறை and adds a stray semicolon.
ta.learn[1].tagline: 'நம்ப முடியாத அளவு' is acceptable and matches learn[1].flags[0].label; style.
ta.learn[2].chat.lines[0]: 'எளிதாகப் பணம் வேண்டுமா' (want money easily?) is natural spoken phrasing for a scam message; style.
ta.learn[2].chat.lines[1]: One case marker on the last item of a list is normal Tamil; போதும் carries 'Just' (same call as SEA-LION triage); the suggestion is longer.
ta.learn[3].chat.lines[0]: சரி (OK) loses 'approved'; அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்டது is the right word.
ta.learn[3].chat.lines[2]: உரிம எண் is the glossary term and the correct compound form.
ta.learn[3].flags[1].label: உரிம எண் is the glossary term; லைசென்ஸ் நம்பர் breaks consistency.
ta.learn[3].todo[1]: 'common' is dropped, but the warning stays correct and the suggestion makes an already long line longer.
ta.learn[4].todo[1]: 'எண்ணை அழை' (accusative) is used for calling numbers across the site (e.g. '1799-ஐ அழையுங்கள்'); changing one line breaks consistency.
ta.learn[5].tagline: Sarvam was wrong: 'யார் அனுப்பியது' is standard; அனுப்பினது is colloquial.
ta.learn[5].chat.lines[1]: Register preference for the scam message; the polite imperative is fine.
ta.learn[5].flags[0].label: Applied with adjustment: முடியவில்லை also reads 'could not', so changed to முடிவதில்லை (does not end), keeping 'என்று' to match learn[5].todo[1]; same length.
ta.act.items[1]: '1799-ல் சரிபாருங்கள்' (check with 1799) keeps CHECK; 'call 1799' changes the mnemonic's verb. Unsure whether readers see 1799 as a phone line here; the other lines say 'call 1799'.
ta.quiz[1].cards[0].why: Clipped but grammatical and parallel to quiz[1].cards[3].why; the suggestion is longer.
ta.quiz[1].cards[1].text: முடக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது (frozen) is correct; லாக் is an English loanword; style.
ta.quiz[1].cards[1].why: பகிர வேண்டாம் and தொலைபேசி match the other OTP lines; the suggestion is longer.
ta.quiz[1].cards[2].why: சதி (scheme) keeps the warning; வாய்ப்பு (opportunity) sounds positive.
ta.quiz[2].chat.from: Same call as SEA-LION triage: உறவினர் (relative) is clear; Latin 'Cousin' not wanted.
ta.quiz[2].chat.lines[1]: An indefinite object ('a code') without accusative is grammatical Tamil.
ta.quiz[2].options[1]: 'எண்ணை அழை' is used consistently across the site; see learn[4].todo[1].
ta.quiz[2].explain: Same as learn[4].todo[1]; the suggestion also has a sandhi slip (அழைத்துப் சரிபாருங்கள்).
ta.quiz[3].options[1].label: அரட்டைச் செய்தி is the term for 'Chat message' on every channel label; style.
ta.quiz[4].msg.bubbles[2][0].t: Sarvam was wrong: CHECK stays in English only in the ACT lines, not inside the scam message.
ta.quiz[4].msg.bubbles[2][2].t: 'your' is implied in Tamil; register preference.
ta.quiz[4].explain: 'your' is implied in Tamil; adding உங்கள் lengthens the line.
ta.quiz[5].chat.lines[1]: Sarvam was wrong: 'பயன்படுத்த அனுமதியுங்கள்' is grammatical; the suggestion has a typo (பயன்படுக்க).
ta.quiz[5].explain: பிறர் and மறுத்து are standard; register preference, and longer.
ta.feedback.csatQuestion: Same call as independent triage: 'How was today's event for you?' fits the happy/unhappy scale.
ta.ui.exitQuiz (independent): Independent has 'leave the question'; live 'Exit' is a deliberate short button label.
ta.ui.example (independent): Live 'போலி' (fake) vs independent 'not real': same intent.
ta.learn[0].chat.lines[1] (independent): Live 'send you to your hometown' is the right idiom for 'sent home'; independent 'to your house' is literal.
ta.learn[0].todo[0] (independent): Independent ends ungrammatically ('MOM-வே மாட்ட'); live is right.
ta.learn[1].tagline (independent): Independent reads 'deal so big it makes you install an app'; live keeps 'too good'.
ta.learn[2].title (independent): Independent 'மோசடி நபர்' (scam person) loses 'mule'; live keeps the glossary term scam mule.
ta.learn[2].chat.lines[1] (independent): Independent turns 'or' into 'and' and drops 'let me'; live is right.
ta.learn[2].todo[1] (independent): Independent is garbled ('jail, jail', 'beat') and says 'wrong' for crime; live is right.
ta.learn[3].todo[0] (independent): Independent has 'registration' for login; live உள்நுழைவு is right.
ta.learn[3].todo[1] (independent): Both drop 'common'; live says no one can 'ask' you to pay vs 'make you pay': same warning.
ta.learn[4].chat.lines[0] (independent): Independent says 'OTP' where the English says 'a code'; live is right.
ta.act.items[1] (independent): Independent reads 'CHECK 1799'; live 'check with 1799' is closer.
ta.quiz[1].cards[0].text (independent): Live 'when coming home' vs 'on the way home': same meaning.
ta.quiz[4].msg.bubbles[0][0].t (independent: Live 'is going to cancel' vs English 'wants to cancel': slight shift, same threat; kept for length.
ta.quiz[4].msg.bubbles[2][0].t (independent: Independent inserts CHECK; live is right.
ta.quiz[5].chat.lines[1] (independent): Independent is ungrammatical ('you can use'); live is right.
ta.quiz[5].options[1] (independent): Independent 'later' instead of 'instead'; live is right.
ta.quiz[5].options[2] (independent): Independent says 'wrong' (தப்பு) for crime; live குற்றம் is right.
